visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and glasses sits on a gray couch in front of a white brick wall, wearing a black ribbed tank top. She holds a smartphone excitedly, smiling broadly while gesturing toward herself; yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) She looks down at her phone with a focused expression, then quickly glances sideways as if addressing someone off-camera, maintaining an energetic posture. (3) The scene shifts to a screen recording of a mobile interface showing Google Maps with the location set to Bali; the user scrolls through hotel listings and selects 'Kutabex Beach Front Hotel' among several pins. (4) The screen recording continues within the Agoda booking interface, navigating a calendar to select dates from August 14 to August 18, 2025, and adjusting the guest count to two people. (5) A pricing breakdown is shown on the screen, highlighting a coupon discount and a final total price in NT$, followed by a quick visual comparison of two different price points. (6) The woman reappears, sitting next to a stack of books on the couch, looking at her phone and then pointing at it while speaking animatedly with a playful, competitive expression. (7) She raises her hand in a celebratory fist pump, laughing and cheering toward the camera while the background remains the same studio-like living room setting. (8) A plush otter toy is shown sitting on the couch with a graphic overlay of sweat drops and '?' marks near its head, creating a humorous reaction shot.
